import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
d=G['Demo pair 1 input']; o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
diff=[(r,c,d[r][c],o[r][c]) for r in range(len(d)) for c in range(len(d[0])) if d[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
print(diff)
# find 2s and 3-blocks in input
for r in range(len(d)):
    print(' '.join(str(x) for x in d[r]))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
I=G['Demo pair 2 input']; O=G['Demo pair 2 output']
d=[(r,c,O[r][c]) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]]

import os,re,json,glob
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
gi=G['Test input']
# Last idea: output has 3s turned into 2 where they overlap lines; everything else zeroed except the vertical lines.
out=[[0 if v==0 and c not in (2,7,11,17) else v for c,v in enumerate(row)] for row in gi]
for r in range(16):
    for c in (2,7,11,17): out[r][c]=2
print(json.dumps(out))
